about: The wiki under server execution on the two clients (design §2.2, mock docs/mocks/wiki/35; contracts/wiki.contract.json
`jobs.read`, `jobs.executor.read`, `systemModel.read`, P9): the settings page and Set up while the server runs the
account's wiki, the System model's five states as they read there, and Activity's Runs — each run's row and each
call's row of its log. The web reads this file in `lib/wikiRuns.test.ts`, `lib/wikiReviewMode.test.ts`,
`WikiServerExecutionCopyParityTests` (`WikiRunsCopy`, `WikiRunsLogic`, `WikiModeCopy`), so the two ends cannot drift into
two sentences. The status line's server reasons are cases of `wiki-health.fixture.json`, the line's own fixture.
Times are read at `now`. A run case is a `GET /api/wiki/spaces/:id/jobs` job and the row the Runs card draws for it:
`kind`, `state` and `text` (what follows the state, ` · ` between its parts), `mark`, `tone` and `when`. A call case is
one of its `requests` and the log's row: `call`, `state`, `retries`, `tone`, `waited`, `ran`, `tokens`, the phone's

fields.label: Reads the repository from
fields.note: The runner that checks out this codebase; the server reads the repository there.

fields.label: Model
fields.note: Set by this deployment, the same for every space.

fields.label: Daily limit
fields.note: A run starts when 20 sessions have settled, or when the oldest waits a day. Each run writes at most 30 changes.

fields.label: Look back
fields.note: How far back maintenance starts reading when you turn it on. Changing it later never moves maintenance back.

settings.maintenanceNote: Keeps the wiki up to date from sessions, tasks and receipts as they settle. Runs on the server with this deployment’s System model.
settings.privacy: The wiki sends its material — session summaries, entries and repository excerpts — to this deployment’s System model.
settings.automaticNote: The System model checks each change against its sources first: supported ones apply, partly supported ones show as Unreviewed, the rest are rejected with a reason.
